supersession_reason: The v1 packet carried SHA-256 values from local candidate serializations. Shadow reconciliation now binds Git-tracked parent inputs by exact implementation ref, receipt ref, path, and Git blob identity.
goal: Freeze provider-neutral v1 wire contracts and generate reproducible Kotlin and Swift bindings without leaking provider SDK types or private control-plane values.
non_goals: implement Android, Apple, LiteRT-LM, model, skill or application adapters
merge Foundation, P0, P1 or main branches
accept model, SDK, store or legal terms
read private Google Workspace locations or private document bytes
claim native runtime, device, model-quality, privacy, energy or thermal acceptance
required_contract_surfaces: inference request and streaming event envelope
model artifact reference and provenance identity
tool definition, proposal, admission decision and result
skill metadata and immutable skill reference
bounded DAG, node, effect, cancellation, retry and fallback semantics
evidence lane, subject, digest, state and handoff identity
typed error taxonomy and compatibility/version metadata
hard_invariants: provider-specific Android, Apple or LiteRT-LM SDK types never cross the v1 boundary
private Workspace URLs, resolver values, roadmap, prompt history, credentials, private data and Human approvals never enter generated/public contracts
model output remains candidate data and never implies tool execution authority
requested accelerator is distinct from runtime-observed backend
source-code license, model terms, dataset terms and SDK/store terms remain separate values
start-readiness and completion-readiness remain separate edges
wire evolution is explicitly versioned and breaking changes fail compatibility gates
one deterministic generator owns generated JSON Schema, Kotlin and Swift bytes

required_positive_gates: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation for every v1 schema
deterministic generator replay produces identical bytes and digest

generated Swift package compiles in isolation on the admitted toolchain

full deterministic test suite remains green

unknown field or unversioned envelope fails closed
wrong parent ref or Git blob fails convergence admission
cheaper evidence lane cannot satisfy LIVE_DEVICE, PRIVATE or HUMAN fields

worker_protocol.p1_input_read: Read P1 inputs from the exact immutable Git ref; do not merge P1 or copy private values.
worker_protocol.writer_rule: P2 is the sole writer for allowed_paths; P0/P1 paths are read-only inputs.
worker_protocol.convergence_rule: Do not auto-resolve semantic disagreement between P0 and P1. Record conflict and stop for Tech Lead/Human review.
worker_protocol.publication_rule: Open a Draft PR only after real v1 contract and generated-binding bytes exist and all static gates run.

evidence_ceiling: This packet admits P2 contract implementation only. It does not prove native provider integration, physical devices, model quality, private carrier authorization, legal acceptance, merge or release.
